sentences.text: The petitioner, namely, Md. Rafiqul Ali, was charge-sheeted in the aforesaid case and he appeared before the Trial Court.

Thereafter, on some dates he defaulted in appearance and therefore,
non-bailable warrant of arrest was directed to be issued against him.
The petitioner submits that his father was suffering from cancer and that is the reason why he could not appear before the Trial Court on those dates.
In view of above, I am of the considered opinion that the petitioner has satisfactorily explained the cause of his failure to appear before the Trial Court.
Therefore, the impugned orders directing issuance of non-bailable warrant of arrest against the petitioner, namely, Md. Rafiqul Ali are set aside.
The petitioner is directed to appear before the Trial Court on 20.12.2023 for seeking relief and in the meantime, he shall be allowed remain on previous bail.
With the aforesaid direction, the criminal petition stands disposed of.
